title: Named-instance service edge routing
snippet:
77  /v1/instances/<protocol-instance>/operations/gateway/relay-instant
   78  /v1/instances/<protocol-instance>/delegations/gateway/relay-delegation
   79  /v1/instances/<protocol-instance>/operations/gateway/relay-native-gas-top-up
   80  /v1/instances/<protocol-instance>/deposits/deposit-fee-config
   81  ```
   82  
   83  The gateway hashes the key with SHA-256, looks it up in the hot-reloaded
   84  `services/auth-gateway/gateway.yaml`, checks `allowed_services` and `allowed_instances`, applies the
   85  client's per-instance token-bucket rate limit, resolves the selected instance upstream, and proxies
   86  to the internal FastAPI service. The gateway also sends the instance-aware `X-Forwarded-Prefix`, so
   87  FastAPI renders Swagger/OpenAPI links under the same
   88  public prefix without Nginx HTML rewriting. Forwarded OpenAPI responses use that gateway prefix as
   89  the schema server and expose paths relative to it, so Swagger "Try it out" calls
   90  `/v1/operations/{request_id}` rather than duplicating the service alias or internal `/v1`.
   91  
   92  Swagger UI is available below `/v1/instances/<protocol-instance>/<service>/docs`. The OpenAPI schema
   93  documents Bearer, Basic, and `X-API-Key` gateway auth, so Swagger's **Authorize** control can send
   94  the selected credentials with "Try it out" requests. The docs page, Redoc, OpenAPI JSON, and Swagger OAuth
   95  redirect routes are public read-only gateway routes; operation and deposit API calls still require
   96  a valid client key. Direct host-published API ports are for local development and internal operator
   97  checks; public deployments should expose the auth gateway instead.
   98  
   99  ## Story 1 Flow: Signed Account Operations
  100  
  101  ```text
  102  Frontend
  103    |
  104    | POST /v1/operations/gateway/relay-instant
  105    | Authorization: Bearer <client-key>, Authorization: Basic <base64(username:client-key)>, or X-API-Key
  106    v
  107  auth-gateway
  108    |
